verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no versioned public API scheme and no documented deprecation policy for Temporal's APIs. The versioning evidence covers Worker Versioning and Workflow Definition versioning, which let users roll out their own workflow code changes. That is an adjacent feature, not a versioned API contract with deprecation guarantees, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
